create_DistillationLoss: create a DistillationLoss module wrapping a base criterion with teacher model for knowledge distillation
build_distillation_loss_soft: build a soft knowledge distillation loss using KL divergence between student and teacher log-softmax outputs
build_distillation_loss_hard: build a hard knowledge distillation loss using cross entropy between student dist predictions and teacher argmax
test_DistillationLoss_forward: test the DistillationLoss forward method with inputs, model outputs, and labels
review_DistillationLoss_init: review the DistillationLoss __init__ method parameters including base_criterion, teacher_model, distillation_type, alpha, and tau
